The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that 6-Acetonyldihydrochelerythrine may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the kinase, which could influence the activity of the transporter. The evidence is supported by a direct interaction between the compound and the transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
